verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of automatic receipt-to-transaction matching, e-receipt pulling from integrations (e.g., email or vendor portals), or smart nudging logic for missing receipts specifically. Only a generic marketing claim about 'AI-powered spend management' and transactions being 'controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant' appears (bill-spend-expense-docs-9), which does not describe this specific capability.
